study type: Observational comparative study with pre/post-operative measurements
cohort: The study included 48 severe preeclampsia women, 16 mild preeclampsia women, 22 normotensive pregnant women, and 20 non-pregnant women.
finding: The level of GPIba was significantly lower in the severe preeclampsia group compared to other groups, and it increased significantly after cesarean section in severe preeclampsia patients.
mod_finding: GPIba levels in severe preeclampsia patients were found to be higher 72 hours after cesarean section compared to before the operation.
